Processing script data/goldberg_2018_escs.py.
note: Code derivation: data/goldberg_2018_escs.py melts DOP.tab with var_name='item' and renames nothing; BLOCK_NAMES[('dop','vig_')]='ab5c_vignettes', so live codes vig_1..vig_90 ARE the source column names (core model s3 pattern 1). But the .sav's variable labels are bare ('Vig_1'..'Vig_90') and its value labels bare numbers 1..9, so the code->text tie is NOT data_labels: it rests on reading the 90 printed vignettes (unnumbered on the form) top-to-bottom, pp.1-7, as vig_1..vig_90 -> mapping_basis=paper_order. Supporting convention in the same file: the sibling ai_ block's numbering follows the form's print order (DOP_scales.sps: music=ai_1 'Listened to music on the radio', religion=ai_2, computng=ai_3, sports=ai_4, housekp=ai_5 'Washed dishes', ... socialnt=ai_10, all matching print positions). Verified (PARTIAL) against the same respondents' NEO-PI-R domain scores (ESCS doi:10.7910/DVN/HE6LJR, NEO_PIR_scales.tab datafile 3135106, sha256 a7db1bce82dd11ffb87606b24577f7dc24ea7fae5af97877ba071cc3db2d9714; n=567 overlap): predicted domain+sign coded from wording matches the max-|r| NEO domain for 82/90 vignettes (87/90 allowing a pre-listed AB5C blend); the 3 misses (vig_19, 22, 61) have the predicted domain with the correct sign as the second-largest r (-0.26 tie, +0.32 vs 0.34, +0.29 vs 0.42). Shifting the text +/-1..3 positions gives 0-9/90. Order within a domain x sign class is not established. See verify_goldberg_2018_dop_ab5c_vignettes.R. Text: pdftotext -layout of DOP.pdf, spot-checked against a page-1 render; line breaks joined with single spaces. Deviation: each vignette's final full stop merges with the dot leaders on the form, so a terminal '.' was supplied for all 90 (vig_70 prints it visibly, 'myself.' before the circles). Otherwise verbatim, incl. straight quotes in vig_57 ("just right") and vig_84 ('get it'). Option<->resp: printed scale box 1 Extremely unlike me, 3 Moderately unlike me, 5 Neither like nor unlike me, 7 Moderately like me, 9 Exactly like me; 2,4,6,8 are unlabelled on the form and ship with blank option_text. The script stores the .sav integers unchanged: .sav per-item x level counts equal live 810/810 cells (57,347 rows, 639 ids, from the local irw cache; no new export). Direction corroborated: E+ vignettes correlate positively with NEO E (e.g. vig_1 +0.49). instructions = the printed lead-in, verbatim. instrument = form title + deposit title + technical report description ('90 vignette personality descriptions corresponding to the 90 facet poles in the Abridged Big Five-dimensional Circumplex (AB5C) model of Hofstee, de Raad, & Goldberg (1992)') -- composed. One trivial section_id. Step 3b: dictionary '90 AB5C facet-pole vignettes, resp 1-9, 639 x 90' matches the 90 printed vignettes and the 9-point scale; the 209 ai_ avocational items on pp.7+ are a separate table. Rights: vignettes are authored for this study by Goldberg/ORI and published in Goldberg's own CC0 deposit; no restriction on the wording located or stated (silence). AB5C model is IPIP-related (register: IPIP=ship), but these vignettes are not IPIP items as such. No register row written.
